changes: Fixes Mini Verb on T3 and T7 writing into Sidechain Compressor's memory, which could leak one track's audio into another in a card build with both.
Mini Verb and Sidechain Compressor can be picked together in a card build again. The sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged.
Over USB the base still keeps Mini Verb off T3 and T7 while Sidechain Compressor is installed.
Known issue: this version is not yet tested on hardware.
Uses slightly less DSP time with the same sound, so over USB it fits on the smaller DSP core beside seven stock effects.
Controls, defaults and saved projects are unchanged.
Beta base update: picking Mini Verb no longer shows DSP MEMORY FULL just because the effects of the bank's other Parts don't all fit.
No longer offered beside Sidechain Compressor: on T3 and T7 a build with both could leak one track's audio into another.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware, and it is not confirmed that the THRU noise reported in #428 is gone.
Fixes clipping at hot input levels when MIX is between dry and wet. MIX 32 is still 25% wet and MIX 0 still fully dry.
The reverb, controls and saved settings are unchanged; output that did not clip can differ by a tiny amount.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware, and it is not confirmed that this fixes the THRU noise reported in #428.
Media only: adds an audio preview, recorded with 0.2.0 before this fix.
Moves MIX from upper-right encoder C to lower-right encoder F and adds TONE above it.
TONE is neutral at 64; darker settings low-pass the wet output and brighter settings high-pass it. The feedback tank and DAMP are unchanged.
After updating: old MIX values, locks, scenes and LFO destinations on slot C now drive TONE. Set TONE back to 64 and move MIX settings and automation to slot F.
Known issue: this version is not yet tested on hardware.
Documentation only: adds emulator screenshots of the selection and control pages and how to reach them.
Documentation only: updates the author credits.
First Modwerk catalog release of the full-rate stereo FX2 reverb, on its own effect ID beside DARK REV.
